set_seed: set a random seed for python, numpy, and torch reproducibility
print_dataset_info: print the size and number of classes of a PyTorch dataset
freeze_weights: freeze all model weights except those in the final fully connected layer
convert_state_dict_if_from_pl: extract and clean a state dict from a PyTorch-Lightning checkpoint file
choose_last_fc_mode: choose whether to use the last fully connected layer for score or feature mode
